assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official site boundary and the three key-area polygons are not yet published; the package uses provisional_constraint geometry from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: After official polygons are supplied, all areas, ratios, figures, drawings, visual page and self-check results must be recalculated and regenerated; provisional geometry must not be treated as an official redline.

assumptions.statement: Current population and employment data (district/sub-district level) and commuting OD are missing; industrial space scale and service facility sizing are therefore indicative only.
assumptions.impact: Supplement with census/economic-census data, mobile-signal commuting OD and enterprise directory before finalizing industrial space and public service facility programs.

assumptions.statement: Topography (DEM/slope) and engineering geology/hydrogeology data are missing; building height, massing and development intensity proposals are concept-level.
assumptions.impact: Confirm geotechnical and geological conditions before any statutory intensity or height controls are set.

assumptions.statement: Upper-level planning documents (Beijing master plan, Haidian district plan, ongoing regulatory detailed plans, historic-city conservation plan) have not been incorporated into this package.
assumptions.impact: Planning-control indicators (FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines) remain pending confirmation until upper-level and statutory plan coordination is completed.

assumptions.statement: Environmental baseline data (air, water, noise, soil) and ecological sensitivity assessment are missing; green and ecological network design relies on qualitative judgment.
assumptions.impact: Environmental impact baseline and ecological red-line/sensitivity layers are required for formal ecological carrying-capacity conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Municipal utility network, energy, drainage, flood control and fire-safety engineering data are missing.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and new-infrastructure proposals are spatial strategies; they require utility surveys and special studies as formal deepening prerequisites.

assumptions.statement: Current road network hierarchy, traffic volume, rail station ridership and parking supply data are missing.
assumptions.impact: Traffic organization conclusions are provisional design discussions until traffic surveys and capacity studies are completed.
